value.rationale: Paley-17 is the classical extremal (4,4)-Ramsey graph and a canonical self-complementary strongly regular graph. The natural 136-element symmetry group acts on an already known 16-sphere homology group, but the rank alone does not tell whether it is 16 trivial lines, a permutation representation, or an irreducible module. The complete augmentation-character identification, including the rational irreducibility on the prime-order translation group and all 136 traces, supplies substantive symmetry information not in the nonequivariant prior work.
